title: Operating Lines of Credit Variable Rate Sheet — Spreads, Floors and Discount Allowances
content:
All Operating Lines of Credit carry a variable rate priced off the Association Variable Base Rate. This sheet states, for each product, the spread, the rate floor and the discount allowances in percentage points.

## Columns

- **Spread**: the percentage points added to the Association Variable Base Rate to set the contract rate before discounts.
- **Floor**: the lowest contract rate the line can carry after all discounts, annual percent.
- **Program discount**: the young, beginning and small farmer program discount off the contract rate, in percentage points.
- **AutoDraft discount**: the discount for interest collected by AutoDraft, in percentage points.
- **Relationship discount**: the discount when the member also holds a Farm Real Estate loan in active status, in percentage points.
- **Discount cap**: the most the program, AutoDraft and relationship discounts may take off together, in percentage points.

## Rate sheet

| Product | Spread (points) | Floor (% a year) | Program discount (points) | AutoDraft discount (points) | Relationship discount (points) | Discount cap (points) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | 0.65 | 5.25 | 1.00 (1) | 0.125 | 0.10 (0.1) | 1.125 |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit | 0.90 (0.9) | 5.50 (5.5) | 0 | 0.125 | 0.10 (0.1) | 0.225 |
| Seasonal Operating Loan | 0.55 | 5.25 | 0 | 0.125 | 0.10 (0.1) | 0.225 |
| Revolving Operating Line | 0.30 (0.3) | 5.00 (5) | 0 | 0.125 | 0.15 | 0.275 |
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | 0.10 (0.1) | 4.75 | 0 | 0 | 0.15 | 0.15 |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | -0.15 (a negative spread: 0.15 points below the base rate) | 4.50 (4.5) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

A discount shown as 0 is a discount the product does not offer.

## Reading the sheet

The Agribusiness Revolving Line is the only product priced below the base rate, and it offers no discounts at all. The StartRight Operating Line is the only product with a program discount, and its discount cap of 1.125 points is large enough to take the whole program discount together with the AutoDraft discount.

*Hypothetical illustration:* with a base rate of 7.000% a year, the Revolving Operating Line spread gives 7.300% before any discount, and the Agribusiness Revolving Line spread gives 6.850%.
